# Development installers

**Latest: V2 Development Build 7.** Both Build 6 and Build 7 are published here on **Development**, not Stable. The repository defaults to Stable, so use [this Development branch link](https://github.com/bluesilent9/wallaby-agent/tree/Development) to view current code.

| Version | Installer | Matching source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| V2 Development Build 7 | [Download Build 7 DEB](https://github.com/bluesilent9/wallaby-agent/raw/refs/heads/Development/dist/wallaby-agent_2.0.0~dev7_amd64.deb) | [Build 7 source](https://github.com/bluesilent9/wallaby-agent/tree/8731a90f4adc24f0ac0345b1ab7f70aed5ffdee0) |
| V2 Development Build 6 | [Download Build 6 DEB](https://github.com/bluesilent9/wallaby-agent/raw/refs/heads/Development/dist/wallaby-agent_2.0.0~dev6_amd64.deb) | [Build 6 source](https://github.com/bluesilent9/wallaby-agent/tree/b2b44e7983940e7a758969e4244df5d2e6f4c6dc) |

Both target Ubuntu 26.04 LTS amd64. Verify [SHA256SUMS.txt](SHA256SUMS.txt). Historical packages remain for reference. Build 7 unsigned vault composition/signature-return/broadcast use Dashboard Build 8; wallet synchronisation additionally requires [the signed-preview relay update](../DASHBOARD_PREVIEW_UPDATE.md).

[Read the signing audit warning, build details and limitations](../README.md) before use. These are Development builds; Stable has not been changed.
